text:
Maria Gonzalez: Quick sync — finalizing POC success criteria for Acadia Health (enterprise). Need sign-off on metrics, eval prompts, timeline (4 weeks), and expansion triggers. Ping @Alex Chen @Ben Patel for perf/cost, @Samir Rahman for infra/security.

Alex Chen: From infra: baseline on hosted API with redwood/llama-13b-q4 gives ~320ms 95th percentile for ~120 token responses in our internal tests. Throughput approx 16k tokens/sec/GPU with batching. For Dedicated we can target lower 95th p. Need their expected RPS and representative prompts to refine numbers.

Ben Patel: Proposed success metrics: 1) Functionality — eval pass rate >= 88% on a labelled QA set. 2) Latency — 95th <= 350ms hosted, <=200ms Dedicated. 3) Cost — target cost per 1k tokens (TBD after RPS). 4) Reliability — error rate <1%. 5) Safety — flagged outputs <0.5% on safety tests. Recommend 500-case eval harness across intents + edge cases; if top-2 accuracy >=90% -> recommend pilot expansion.

Samir Rahman: Security checklist: they requested SAML SSO, VPC peering, KMS support, and data residency controls. We have SOC2 and encryption docs ready. I'll attach the filled security questionnaire. Note: Private deployment + KMS adds ~2–3 weeks operational lead time. Link to answers: https://redwood.internal/security/acadia-poc-answers

Emily Carter: Commercial questions — POC pricing: standard internal practice is 50% off hosted consumption for the 30-day POC. Dedicated pilots usually need a nominal reservation (example: $5k/mo pilot credit) — can confirm. Post-POC expansion options will be tiered commitments; I'll draft a few SKUs once Alex gives expected token usage.

Maria Gonzalez: Timeline proposal — Week0 kick + infra access; Week1 integration + sample prompts; Week2 evals & prompt tuning; Week3 perf/load tests; Week4 readout + expansion proposal. Target readout: Friday 4 weeks from now. Any objections?

Ben Patel: Sounds good. I'll own the eval harness + final pass metric. Will provide runner + scoring script.

Alex Chen: I'll own perf runs and cost estimate. Can deliver a perf runbook and expected monthly token estimate if they give sample prompts and RPS by EOD tomorrow.

Samir Rahman: I'll complete security questionnaire and schedule an SSO demo. Need a PO for non-prod VPC access.

Maria Gonzalez: Owners recap — Ben: evals; Alex: perf & cost; Samir: security; Emily: commercial. Next actions: Ben drop eval harness link, Alex send cost estimate, Samir attach security answers. :thumbsup:

Emily Carter: ack :thumbsup:

Ben Patel: Dropping eval harness here: https://git.redwood/poc/acadia-eval — contains 500 cases + runner and scoring. Example eval case and prompt style:```
# Eval sample
Prompt: "User: Summarize the following patient note and highlight medication changes."
Expected: "Short summary with meds and dosage changes called out."
```

Alex Chen: I'll run a quick perf sweep against their sample set once Ben's harness is in. Will post numbers and cost estimate in this thread.

Samir Rahman: Security answers uploaded and shared with legal: https://redwood.internal/security/acadia-poc-answers (internal). I'll also request the PO contact for VPC access.

Maria Gonzalez: Great — I'll schedule the readout for 2025-09-05 10:00 PT and send invites. If we hit the success metrics we'll present 3 expansion options (small / medium / enterprise reserved). Thanks everyone, will follow up with calendar + action tracker.
